messages:
Alex Chen: OK team — kicking off Taipei region launch with ZenAsia. Goal: marketplace listing + Dedicated capacity in TPE-1 by June. Need partner quota confirmations, KMS path, and any legal/PR blockers. :rocket:
Marina Lopez: thanks Alex. looping in ZenAsia rep Tomo. can we get estimated GPU count and whether they’ll provide reserved SKUs? cc @Samir for infra sizing
Tomo (ZenAsia): hi all — ZenAsia confirmed initial pool: 8xA100-80GB reserved, ability to burst to 12 for 4 weeks. marketplace SKUs need our billing id (zenasia-tpe) and reporting tags.
Samir Patel: sounds good. Samir here — can we get peak qps and avg seq length? will affect autoscale policy and placement.
Alex Chen: good call. Tomo — quick template below we can use to size:```yaml
expected_rps: 120
avg_seq_len: 512
burst_weeks: 4
reserved_gpus: 8
```. fill and send?
Tomo (ZenAsia): sending offline to Marina — will reply in 24h. we need to confirm KMS integration — we use CloudHaven KMS (customer-managed). is HSM required?
Kevin Ortiz: HSM not required for hosted marketplace, but for Private deployments we need HSM. For TPE marketplace, standard KMS integration is fine; just need key alias + kmsARN.
Jia Nguyen: legal note: marketplace terms need local consumer protection addendum for TW. Also, we need data locality clause for Dedicated customers. I'll draft the addendum; ETA 48h.
Marina Lopez: great. on PR/announce cadence — product marketing wants a coordinated go/no-go 72h before launch. who can own the final capacity sign-off?
Samir Patel: infra can sign off on capacity once we get the filled template and a quick load test plan. I can run smoke tests and capacity soak.
Alex Chen: assign ownership: Samir owns infra sign-off; Marina owns partner/go-to-market; Jia owns legal. I’ll own rollout policy and fallback (route to eu-north if spike).
partner_ops_bot: Checklist created: [Marketplace listing], [KMS details], [Reserved SKU confirmation], [Legal addendum], [Capacity sign-off], [PR sync]. Assigned: Marina, Tomo, Kevin, Jia, Samir, Alex.
Marina Lopez: Tomo — we also need the marketplace billing contact + logo assets (SVG) and a short 1-paragraph partner description. Can you provide?
Tomo (ZenAsia): will share billing contact and assets by EOD tomorrow. partner description: "ZenAsia provides regional cloud GPU capacity with low-latency connectivity across APAC." will tailor if needed.
Samir Patel: scheduling load window — propose Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC for smoke + Wed 22:00-02:00 UTC for soak (can split into 4h blocks). any objections?
Marina Lopez: looks fine. product marketing wants a 30-min rehearsed demo after smoke test.
Alex Chen: good. PR note: embargo until we confirm capacity sign-off. no public comms until @Marina confirms.
Jia Nguyen: legal check — adding standard data retention clause and Taiwan consumer addendum. will post draft here when ready.
Kevin Ortiz: on infra ops — we need network peering details and expected egress. Tomo — what's expected monthly egress?
Tomo (ZenAsia): estimate ~6TB/mo initially, may rise to 20TB after growth. will confirm with billing team.
Marina Lopez: timeline recap: assets + billing contact (Tomo) by EOD tomorrow; filled sizing template (Tomo) within 24h; legal draft (Jia) in 48h; infra smoke/soak (Samir) next Thu/Wed windows; final go/no-go 72h before launch.
Alex Chen: perfect. flagging one risk — quota approval from local cloud marketplace can take 5-7 business days. Marina, can we submit request today if we have artifacts?
Marina Lopez: yes. I’ll open the marketplace ticket as soon as assets are in. Tomo, please add required metadata fields in your response (billing id, contact email, VAT if applicable).
Tomo (ZenAsia): will include VAT and contact. thanks.
Samir Patel: once we have reserved GPU SKUs and KMS ARN, I’ll prep the terraform snippet for dedicated pool and share here:```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "tpe-zenasia" {
  region = "tpe-1"
  gpus = 8
  sku = "zenasia.a100-80"
  kms_key = "arn:cloudhaven:kms:..."
}
```
Marina Lopez: tagging stakeholders: @Alex Chen, @Samir Patel, @Jia Nguyen, @Kevin Ortiz, @Tomo (ZenAsia). will update ticket once assets land. :white_check_mark:
Alex Chen: thanks team — keeping this thread as single source of truth. ping me if any blocker. :thumbsup:
